== Summary ==
Celebrity guest Jeremy Bulloch, "Boba Fett" from the Star Wars trilogy, stands tall as Shannon Baksa, Decipher's Mara Jade, signs photos for fans. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Jeremy Bulloch]], [[Shannon Baksa]].
